page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.16xlarge is a general purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9T95 processor built on the x86_64 architecture, operating at a base clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance is configured with 64 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 core-to-memory allocation ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance does not bundle any local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for operating system and data persistence. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, supporting high throughput for multi-node clusters and network-intensive data transfers. The absence of hardware accelerators such as GPUs and onboard NVMe disks reflects a design focused entirely on standard x86 CPU compute and large memory density. Dedicated core allocation ensures consistent compute capacity without virtualization overcommit, providing steady efficiency for standard enterprise infrastructure.

With 64 dedicated execution threads, 256.0 GB of memory, and 32 Gbps network throughput, Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.16xlarge accommodates multi-tier web application serving, mid-size relational and in-memory databases, batch data processing, continuous integration pipelines, and enterprise resource planning systems.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.16xlarge is a general purpose compute instance built on the x86_64 architecture and virtualized via KVM. Powered by a 2.25 GHz AMD EPYC 9T95 processor, it delivers 64 dedicated vCPUs accompanied by 256.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core. The server configuration includes no local disk storage, relying on external network-attached storage for persistent volumes, and offers a baseline network throughput of 32 Gbps without integrated GPUs. The dedicated core model provides steady compute output free from host resource contention, yielding efficient resource utilization for horizontal scaling. Given its balanced resource footprint and high network capacity, the ecs.g9ae.16xlarge instance accommodates enterprise application servers, batch processing jobs, container orchestration clusters, continuous integration pipelines, and distributed databases requiring predictable CPU and memory allocations.
